summary: Owner asks what changed, since earlier versions worked on the same Wayland setup. The transfer overlay code is unchanged since 2026-10-22. Linux-side changes since then: from 1.0.55 (2026-11-15) releases are built on the Ubuntu 20.04 baseline, and the Flutter engine went 3.47.1 -> 3.47.8 on 2026-11-16; the owner's rolling Manjaro KWin/Mesa/NVIDIA 620 updates are the other candidate. Asked for the last good version and recent pacman graphics updates.
